Brickwork FAQs

Can you build brick steps as part of a new patio?

Yes. We can design and build brick steps at the same time as your patio, so everything matches [PLACEHOLDER: confirm].

Do I need planning permission for a garden wall?

Usually not for a low garden wall. In most cases a wall up to 2 metres high needs no planning permission, or 1 metre next to a road or footpath. Listed buildings and some conservation areas have extra rules [PLACEHOLDER: confirm planning wording].

Is your brickwork guaranteed?

Yes. Our work comes with our guarantee [PLACEHOLDER: confirm guarantee length and terms].
